name: Enchanted Agate
summary: The Enchanted Agate activates the Tower of Arathor's defenses. Apprentice Kryten gives it to you before you enter to search for Trelane's remaining items.

sections.title: At the Tower
sections.body: At Refuge Pointe, Kryten hands over the Enchanted Agate and sends you on to Skuerto for the rest of the details. Press it against a pedestal near the tower's base when you are ready to enter. The gem activates the tower's defenses, clearing your way toward Trelane's remaining items.

faq.q: What does the Enchanted Agate do?
faq.answer: The Enchanted Agate activates the defenses of the Tower of Arathor when pressed against a pedestal near its base.

faq.q: Where do I use the Enchanted Agate?
faq.answer: Press the Enchanted Agate against one of the pedestals near the base of the Tower of Arathor.

faq.q: Who gives me the Enchanted Agate?
faq.answer: Apprentice Kryten gives you the Enchanted Agate at Refuge Pointe, then sends you to Skuerto.

faq.q: Why am I taking the Enchanted Agate into the tower?
faq.answer: The gem activates the tower's defenses before you enter to find Trelane's remaining items.
